_comment: English error details the fork's endpoints send -> keys under serverMessages.errors (frontend/src/i18n/serverMessages). The API keeps its English text; the frontend translates it (utils/serverMessages.ts). 'text' is an exact detail, 'pattern' an anchored JavaScript regex whose named groups become the key's parameters; 'lookup' translates the 'code' group through that i18n section into 'reason'. backend/tests/unit/test_server_messages_table.py fails when a fork error is missing here. 'passThrough' lists the fork errors that are shown as they come (the scan's sample, with '7' for each value).
